title: The Waterfall Beneath the Sea
hook: The tallest waterfall on Earth is entirely submerged beneath the open ocean.
script: The tallest waterfall on Earth is entirely submerged beneath the open ocean. Could an invisible underwater waterfall actually drive our planet's global circulation? In the Denmark Strait, freezing polar water collides with a warmer sea. Being slightly denser, that icy water plummets down a massive slope along the ocean floor. It out-flows a thousand Niagaras combined. That sinking torrent acts like a giant pump, pulling warm tropical water northward. If melting ice weakens this plunge, will Europe freeze while the planet warms?
